claim_boundary: CASP17 3D molecular object coordinate materialized library only. It materializes each source coordinate model from the dry-run plan into a protein-name/object folder with sha256 verification. The default symlink mode avoids duplicating raw coordinate bytes. It does not alter source models, compute native accuracy, serialize a CASP author code, or submit to CASP.
